say:2:1231105001:1.text: Rustport has always been a key maritime hub where unique products from all over the world flow in and out.
say:2:1231105001:1.source_cn: 锈锚港一直以来都是海运枢纽，各地的特色物产都会在这里交汇！

say:3:1231105002:1.text: Scented Tea from the Wilders, furs from the Ashen Wastes, wheat from Ryeham... I've even handled precious jewelry from the capital!
say:3:1231105002:1.source_cn: 绿裔联盟的花茶，荒角沙漠的皮毛，金穗村的麦货……我甚至...

say:4:1231105003:1.text: But with Rustport's blockade, none of these goods can flow through.
say:4:1231105003:1.source_cn: 可如今锈锚港封锁，这些货物无法运入。

say:5:1231105004:1.text: I truly miss Scented Tea with its natural, herbal flavor fragrances... such a pity.
say:5:1231105004:1.source_cn: 我很想念花茶，有一股自然的草木清香。可惜呀……
